prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the chaotic energy of a theatre backstage. On the far left, a tall ladder leans against a brick wall, its rungs worn and dusty. Next to the ladder stands a woman in a velvet cloak, her posture rigid as she holds a silver mirror. A man in a striped shirt sits on a wooden crate near her, tying his shoelaces with focused intensity. In the center foreground, a large trunk with brass latches rests open, revealing layers of fabric inside. Perched atop this trunk is a small tabby cat, grooming its paw with casual indifference. Beside the trunk, a young boy in suspenders points toward a hanging rope, his expression one of urgent warning. The rope itself dangles from the ceiling rafters, frayed at the end, swaying slightly in the draft. To the right of the boy, an older woman in a floral dress looks at a clipboard, her glasses perched precariously on her nose. She stands next to a rolling costume rack filled with colorful garments that spill over the sides. Behind her, a musician in a tuxedo tunes a violin, his bow moving slowly across the strings. A sheet music stand is positioned in front of him, holding pages that flutter in the breeze. Further back, a stagehand in blue overalls hands a wrench to a technician in a grey cap, their fingers brushing during the exchange. The technician kneels beside a spotlight fixture, tightening a bolt with careful precision. Above them, a pulley system hangs from the beams, intricate and complex. On the far right, a dancer in a tutu stretches her leg against a doorframe, her balance perfect. A bouquet of wilting roses lies on the floor near her feet, petals scattered loosely. A coffee cup sits on a nearby table, steam rising faintly from the rim. A pair of heavy curtains frames the background, partially drawn to reveal the darkened stage beyond. There is no digital screen visible in the scene. There is no modern smartphone held by any character. There is no bright sunlight streaming through windows.
